chapter_title: Chương 4: 0004 [Cuộc thi Viết Sáng Tạo Mới?]

segments.title: Chương 4: 0004 [Cuộc thi Viết Sáng Tạo Mới?]
segments.content:
The skinny guy with the crew cut was named Xu Haibo, a good student through and through.

His family background was a bit better than Chen Guiliang's and Xie Yang's; both his parents were teachers at a township school.

After handing in his exam paper, Xu Haibo went back to the dorm. Now, holding the book *The Legend of the Armored Soldier*, he was planning to return it to the off-campus rental bookstore.

"I haven't read it yet. Return it tomorrow," Xie Yang said.

Xu Haibo grumbled, "Why didn't you read it last night? You just had to go to the internet cafe to play games. One more day is 50 cents. Are you paying the rental fee?"

Xie Yang flicked his hair stylishly. "Isn't it just 50 cents? I'll pay for it."

Xu Haibo tossed the novel to Xie Yang and sidled up next to Chen Guiliang. Although he was a good boy, he liked hanging out with the bad student Chen Guiliang.

Because he felt that Chen Guiliang's words and actions were exactly what he wanted to do but didn't dare to.

Though he could not reach it, his heart yearned for it.

Even the nickname "Great Hero Chen" was first shouted by Xu Haibo.

He had always felt that Chen Guiliang was like a chivalrous hero from a novel.

For instance, at the beginning of this semester, Xu Haibo was looking at the tuition receipt and the class schedule, complaining angrily, "Isn't this just random fees? They clearly charged 55 yuan for computer lab fees, but there are no computer classes on the schedule."

"Really?" Chen Guiliang leaned over to look.

The second week, after confirming there really were no computer classes, Chen Guiliang started using his spare time to collect signatures and fingerprints from his classmates one by one.

The third year of high school had 20 classes, totaling 875 students.

Chen Guiliang actually managed to get over 500 students' signatures, successfully forcing the school to refund the computer lab fees for all third-year students!

With that kind of rallying power, he deserved to be the school principal. Such an act left Xu Haibo in utter awe and admiration, making him wish he could be Chen Guiliang's loyal follower from then on.

And Chen Guiliang didn't even show off afterward. He just patted his new shoes and said, "What do I care about your computer fees? I just wanted to get the money back to buy a pair of shoes. If Principal Yan didn't know what was good for him, I would've taken the signatures to the Bureau of Education."

Scurrying over to Chen Guiliang's side in a few steps, Xu Haibo asked curiously, "Great Hero Chen, what happened with your math exam?"

Chen Guiliang couldn't explain, so he could only answer, "I just didn't feel like doing the problems."

"Awesome!"

Xu Haibo immediately gave him a thumbs-up. He thought Chen Guiliang was so cool. Following his own path, rebellious and unrestrained, a real man should act on his own whims.

Unfortunately, he himself was not a real man, just a good student.

Chen Guiliang smiled. "Don't be like me."

Xu Haibo said, "I'm a coward, I don't dare to be like you."

Xie Yang flicked his hair at the right moment. "Bobo, you really should learn from him. You're already in your third year of high school, but you're still like an elementary school student. How are you going to find a girlfriend in the future?"

Xu Haibo only saw Chen Guiliang as an idol and wouldn't give Xie Yang the time of day. "Can you find a girlfriend?"

Xie Yang said boastfully, "A lot of girls have a crush on me, it's just that my standards are too high. It's called choosing quality over quantity. If they're not the prettiest girl in the class, I can't even be bothered to date them."

"Keep bragging!" Xu Haibo said with contempt.

In a moment, the three of them had walked to the vicinity of the old school gate, where two rows of late Qing dynasty buildings were preserved.

The first draft of *Thick Black Theory* was written here.

Outside the school gate, there was a row of small restaurants across the road.

A flood of memories instantly surged in Chen Guiliang's mind.

The restaurant directly opposite the school gate left the deepest impression on him.

It was probably during his second year of high school. He had gone in and ordered a plate of green vegetables, which only cost 1 yuan. Since rice was free, he ended up eating eight bowls of the owner's rice!

He had been starving back then.

Naturally, the proprietress also had a deep impression of Chen Guiliang. She even knew his nickname, calling out whenever she saw him, "Great Hero Chen is here to eat again?"

Chen Guiliang found a table and sat down. "One twice-cooked pork, one fish-fragrant eggplant, one mapo tofu, and a plate of seasonal vegetables. Oh, and three bottles of beer!"

The proprietress was a little surprised and asked, "Eating so much today?"

"Struck it rich, celebrating a little," Chen Guiliang said with a smile.

This was a husband-and-wife business. The husband was in charge of cooking, and the wife was in charge of collecting money. As for other tasks, whoever was free would do them.

The proprietress quickly brought the beer, and the sound of stir-frying came from the kitchen.

"Come on, let's have a toast first!"

Chen Guiliang was very happy at this moment. Getting together with old friends for a meal was a rare treat after entering the workforce.

Xie Yang used a chopstick to skillfully pry open the bottle cap and raised the bottle directly to clink with theirs. "It's rare for Great Hero Chen to be so generous."

Xu Haibo obediently poured his beer and defended Chen Guiliang, "Great Hero Chen has always been very generous."

"Cheers!"

The food hadn't arrived yet, but the three buddies had already started drinking.

Xu Haibo wasn't much of a drinker. He had to pause three times to finish one glass of beer, forcing it all down.

Since he said cheers, he had to drain his glass.

Xie Yang put down his beer bottle and raised a hand to brush the hair out of his eyes. "I'm planning to pursue Zhou Jing."

Xu Haibo said, "Good luck with that."

Chen Guiliang smiled. "If you have that kind of spare time, you might as well go to the internet cafe and level up a few times."

"You think I can't get her?" Xie Yang was unconvinced.

"I also think she'll be hard to get," Xu Haibo analyzed with an air of seriousness. "Your family is from the countryside, hers is from the county town. Your parents are farmers, her parents are doctors. You also go to the internet cafe often, so at this rate, you'll at best get into a second-tier university. She's always in the top ten of our year. Even if she messes up, she can get into an ordinary first-tier university. If she performs normally, she'll definitely go to a key university."

Xie Yang was dejected by this, but he retorted stubbornly, "How materialistic. Love is about mutual affection. You can't measure it with these worldly things."

Chen Guiliang nodded. "It is indeed materialistic."

"See?" Xie Yang instantly regained his confidence.

Who knew Chen Guiliang would continue, "You not being able to get Zhou Jing has nothing to do with any of that. It's purely because you're ugly."

"Fuck, you don't know shit," Xie Yang felt like hitting someone after hearing that.

Xu Haibo continued to advise, "My mom says high school students shouldn't be in relationships. The top priority is to study hard. Get into a good university, then find a good job, and then you can date a better girlfriend."

The more Xie Yang listened, the more depressed he became, and he finally lost his temper. "Your mom says, your mom says! You're a goddamn high school student, can you stop with the 'my mom says'?"

Xu Haibo started to say something but then stopped.

Watching the two of them bicker, Chen Guiliang drank his beer and smiled, suddenly recalling a funny incident.

After the college entrance exam, the usually honest and simple Xu Haibo had suddenly found Chen Guiliang with a mysterious air. He claimed he was no longer a high school student and begged Chen Guiliang to take him to see a pornographic video.

He was all pent-up and needed to vent!

In Xu Haibo's mind, the most outrageous way to vent was to watch a pornographic video; he wanted to see a woman's body.

But it was 2004 by then. Where in the county town could you still find a pornographic video parlor? The two of them searched the streets like idiots.

Finally, their legs aching, they simply went to an internet cafe for an all-nighter. On the enthusiastic recommendation of the cafe manager, they watched *Sex is Zero* and *The Fruit is Ripe* all night.

What a frustratingly beautiful youth.

"The twice-cooked pork is here!"

The proprietress brought out the first dish.

Xie Yang took another swig from his beer bottle, then grabbed a piece of twice-cooked pork and chewed fiercely, saying viciously, "Before the college entrance exam, I'm not going online again. I'm going to study hard, get into the top five of the entire year, and then I'll go after Zhou Jing!"

"You can do it!" Xu Haibo cheered him on.

Chen Guiliang buried his head in his food, too lazy to waste words on him.

"You don't believe me again?" Xie Yang pointed at Chen Guiliang.

Chen Guiliang smiled. "I'd rather believe you can stop jacking off than believe you can quit the internet."

Xie Yang was furious. "I swear right here, if I go online again before the college entrance exam, I'll eat a pound of shit for every time I do! You two are my witnesses."

"Don't bullshit your way into free food and drinks," Chen Guiliang said merrily.

This phrase didn't exist in 2003 yet. Xu Haibo mulled it over for a moment before he understood what "bullshit your way into free food and drinks" meant, and then he slapped his thigh and roared with laughter.

He thought Chen Guiliang was so brilliant, his words were like pearls of wisdom.

Xie Yang downed his beer in one go, then went to get rice and eat. He was planning to study after he was full.

While this punk was gobbling down his food, he was also brainwashing himself: I'm sacrificing so much for Zhou Jing, I'm not even playing Legend of Mir anymore. She'll definitely be moved when she finds out.

Chen Guiliang was also eating quickly. His long-undernourished body seemed to be frantically absorbing energy.

After they had eaten and drunk their fill, Chen Guiliang called the proprietress over to settle the bill.

"Two meat dishes, two vegetable dishes, three bottles of beer. That's exactly 12 yuan."

The prices had gone up this year; it was even cheaper last year.

Chen Guiliang took out the money to pay.

Xu Haibo asked, "Flirty Xie, you said you're going to study hard. Are you still reading *The Legend of the Armored Soldier* or not?"

"Not reading it, take it!" Xie Yang tossed the novel out.

Xu Haibo picked up the novel and went to the rental bookstore twenty-some meters away to return it.

Chen Guiliang went with him. He was quite nostalgic for this place.

There were four bookshelves in the rental store, mostly occupied by pirated web novels. There were also some traditional wuxia and romance novels, as well as currently popular Japanese manga.

There were always some bastards who, not content with their own enjoyment, would tear out the exciting parts to savor over and over again.

While returning the book, Xu Haibo asked, "Boss, has the new volume of *Twin of Brothers* arrived yet?"

The owner replied, "It arrived at noon, but it's been rented out."

Xu Haibo got his deposit back and went to look for other novels. After looking around, he picked a book called *The World of Mercenaries*.

Chen Guiliang had little interest in old-school web novels; he was purely there to accompany his friend.

And to feel a bit nostalgic about his youth.

Outside the rental store, there was also a simple rack holding all sorts of newspapers and magazines.

Chen Guiliang's eyes landed on *Mengya* right away. Because this magazine sold extremely well, it was placed in the most conspicuous spot.

Xu Haibo went to pay for *The World of Mercenaries* and saw Chen Guiliang standing there, staring at the magazine. He directly picked up a copy of *Mengya* and flipped to the submission page. "Your writing is so good, why don't you enter the New Concept Writing Competition?"

The submission information came into view.

There were three days left until the deadline, based on the postmark date.

"I've sold all those books already. Am I still going to be a literary youth in this life?" Chen Guiliang muttered to himself.

Xu Haibo encouraged him, "Maybe you can get recommended for admission to Peking University."

Getting recommended for admission to Peking University was pure fantasy. Prestigious universities like Tsinghua and Peking University had stopped accepting recommended students from the New Concept competition after the third year.

And this was the last year that a few schools were still willing to grant admissions without an exam. Starting from the next competition, there would be no exam exemptions at all.

Chen Guiliang thought about today's math exam; he couldn't solve a single problem. It would be very difficult to rely on his own abilities for the college entrance exam.

Reborn once, he could do well even without going to university.

But if he failed the college entrance exam, it would deeply disappoint his parents. He had to think of a way to muddle through.

There were four copies of *Mengya* left. Chen Guiliang took out 12 yuan and bought all of them.

"Buying so many copies?" Xu Haibo was surprised.

Chen Guiliang pointed to the submission information and explained, "Multiple submissions of the same manuscript are forbidden, but multiple manuscripts in one submission are not. Buy one magazine, and you can submit one manuscript."

When Guo Xiaosi submitted his work back then, he sent in seven pieces at once.

They both paid and were about to head back to the dorm, but Xie Yang was nowhere to be seen.

"Flirty Xie!" Xu Haibo called out loudly.

Xie Yang, holding a novel, emerged from behind a bookshelf, walked up to the bookstore owner, and complained, "You didn't even tell me there was a new *Zichuan* out."

Xu Haibo asked, "Didn't you plan to quit the internet and study hard from now on?"

Xie Yang flicked his hair and said brazenly, "I only said I'd quit the internet. I never said I wouldn't read novels."
